units.source_text: 舞台上，一个身穿粉红色外套和青色内衣的女子，

en.t: On the stage, a woman wearing a pink outer jacket and a blue undergarment,

units.source_text: 从啤酒瓶里无休无止地把万国旗拽出来，

en.t: kept endlessly pulling flags of all nations out of a beer bottle,

units.source_text: 最后一面是大太阳旗，吧嗒吧嗒地摇晃着。

en.t: and the last one was a large rising sun flag, fluttering with a flapping sound.

units.source_text: 这位女子每拽一面旗，就要一二一二地数数。

en.t: Each time the woman pulled out a flag, she counted, one two, one two.

units.source_text: 每次数数，就忽左忽右一遍遍地扬起她那长长的下巴颏。

en.t: Whenever she counted, she lifted her long chin again and again, now to the left, now to the right.

units.source_text: 阿光连这个也都看见了。

en.t: O-Mitsu had seen all of this too.
